title: Flip absent-key defaults: uat_stop=close, staging opt-in
action: Per D1: in uat.rs uat_stop_config, the both-keys-absent arm returns Some(UatStop::Close) instead of Some(UatStop::Merge); update the doc comment (absent no longer means today's-merge behavior — it means close placement: merge lands, worktree held while uat pending). Per D2: in verbs/staging/mod.rs staging_before_merge_config, None => Some(false); update its doc comment and the STAGING_DISABLED refusal text so it names the new default (staging is opt-in; set staging_before_merge: true to enable — 'absent or false' disables, remove 'or remove the key to re-enable'). Update existing tests that assert the old absent-key defaults, and add two tests pinning the new ones (absent uat_stop == Close; absent staging_before_merge == false). Update .bee/config-sample.json live values + _doc strings for uat_stop/uat_before_merge/staging_before_merge to state the new absent-key defaults (sample uat_stop stays an explicit value showing the shape, set it to "close"; staging_before_merge sample value false), and docs/config-reference.md rows for the same three keys (absent-means column). Do NOT touch README.md (other cell owns nothing there either; README sync happens after merge).

truths: Both uat keys absent resolves to UatStop::Close
staging_before_merge absent resolves to false and staging add refuses STAGING_DISABLED
Explicit uat_stop/uat_before_merge/staging_before_merge values keep their existing meanings

trace.outcome: Flipped absent-key defaults: uat_stop reads as close, staging_before_merge reads as false; repinned every ripple fixture across uat.rs, staging/mod.rs, worktree/tests.rs, drivers/close.rs, drivers/tests.rs, and tests/cells_archive_sweep.rs

report.outcome: uat_stop absent-key default flipped Merge->Close; staging_before_merge absent-key default flipped true->false; doc strings and config-sample.json updated; every test fixture that assumed the old absent-key defaults across uat.rs, staging/mod.rs, worktree/tests.rs, drivers/close.rs, drivers/tests.rs, and tests/cells_archive_sweep.rs repinned to keep testing what it was about (either explicit old-value config for placement-specific tests, or explicit off/opt-in for unrelated fixtures)
